title: Pinned tensor restriction preserves the pullback unit on stalks
statement: Let $k:X'\to X$ be a morphism of schemes, let $U\subseteq X$ and $U'\subseteq X'$ be open subschemes with inclusions $i$ and $i'$, and let $j:U'\to U$ satisfy $j;i=i';k$. Let $M$ be an $\mathcal O_X$-module and $z\in U'$. Put $N=M|_U$. For a scheme morphism $a:Y\to Z$, a point $y\in Y$ and an $\mathcal O_Z$-module $F$, write $\eta_{a,y,F}:F_{a(y)}\to(a^*F)_y$ for the additive stalk map of the pinned tensor-pullback adjunction unit [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction], followed by the canonical pushforward-stalk map. All module stalks use [def-pc-module-stalk-functor]. Let $\gamma_i:N_{j(z)}\to M_{i(j(z))}$ and $\gamma_o:((k^*M)|_{U'})_z\to(k^*M)_{i'(z)}$ be the canonical open-stalk comparisons, including the slice-site restriction equivalence. Let $t:M_{i(j(z))}\to M_{k(i'(z))}$ be stalk transport along the point equality induced by $j;i=i';k$. Let $\beta:(k^*M)|_{U'}\xrightarrow{\sim}j^*(M|_U)$ be the pinned restriction comparison [def-pc-open-pinned-single-tensor-restriction-iso], whose composition factors are [def-pc-tensor-pullback-composition-iso]. Then the following two additive maps from $N_{j(z)}$ to $(k^*M)_{i'(z)}$ agree: $\gamma_i;t;\eta_{k,i'(z),M}=\eta_{j,z,N};(\beta^{-1})_z;\gamma_o$.

proof.text: Expand the inverse pinned restriction into its four factors. The two open comparison factors identify adjunction units by Adjunction.unit_leftAdjointUniq_hom_app; the two composition factors identify composite units by unit_conjugateEquiv_symm. Naturality moves the input open comparison through the unit for j, and the composition identities cancel using the commuting square hj. Thus the inverse pinned comparison preserves the restricted adjunction unit.

Apply additive stalk maps to this unit equality. On a section germ the stalk map of a unit followed by stalkPushforward is the germ of the pulled-back section, by stalkFunctor_map_germ and stalkPushforward_germ. The hom formulas for restrictStalkNatIso identify the open factors with the ambient germs; stalkCongr accounts for the equality of input points induced by hj. Every stalk element is a section germ, so stalk_hom_ext gives the displayed equality of maps.

proof_origin.note: Extract the unit-compatibility part of the canonical generator calculation, independently of tensor coordinates, complexes and cartesian base-change squares.

theorem openPinnedTensorRestriction_stalk_unit
    {X X' : Scheme.{u}} (k : X' ⟶ X)
    (U : X.Opens) (U' : X'.Opens) (j : U'.toScheme ⟶ U.toScheme)
    (hj : j ≫ U.ι = U'.ι ≫ k) (M : X.Modules) (z : U'.toScheme) :
    let N := (schemeOpenRestriction X U).obj M
    let L₀ := RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor U'.toScheme.toRingedSpace z
    let F₀ := forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} (U'.toScheme.presheaf.stalk z)) AddCommGrpCat.{u}
    let Lᵢ := RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor U.toScheme.toRingedSpace (j z)
    let Fᵢ := forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} (U.toScheme.presheaf.stalk (j z))) AddCommGrpCat.{u}
    let γ := Functor.isoWhiskerRight (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U') (L₀ ⋙ F₀) ≪≫
      Scheme.Modules.restrictStalkNatIso U'.ι z
    let γᵢ := Functor.isoWhiskerRight (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U) (Lᵢ ⋙ Fᵢ) ≪≫
      Scheme.Modules.restrictStalkNatIso U.ι (j z)
    let hx := congrArg (fun t : U'.toScheme ⟶ X ↦ t z) hj
    γᵢ.hom.app M ≫ (M.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq hx)).hom ≫
        (TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (k z.val)).map
          (Scheme.Modules.Hom.mapPresheaf
          ((Classical.choose (Scheme.Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction k)).unit.app M)) ≫
        ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback k).obj M).presheaf.stalkPushforward
          AddCommGrpCat.{u} k.base z.val =
      (TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (j z)).map
          (Scheme.Modules.Hom.mapPresheaf
          ((Classical.choose (Scheme.Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction j)).unit.app N)) ≫
        ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback j).obj N).presheaf.stalkPushforward
          AddCommGrpCat.{u} j.base z ≫
        F₀.map (L₀.map ((openPinnedTensorRestrictionIso k U U' j hj).inv.app M)) ≫
        γ.hom.app ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback k).obj M)
